programization_defect: All stablecoin actions execute only at the first next-minute open after event finalization. The frozen route grouped and occupied the global slot by decision_ms, so an earlier event in the same minute could reserve the slot before any order was executable and suppress a later event that was also fully known by the shared entry_ms.

correction.candidate_clock: retain every event-specific causal feature row and probability
correction.competition_clock: sort and group candidates by executable entry_ms rather than decision_ms
correction.same_entry_choice: among all candidates known before the same executable entry, choose the highest precomputed cost-adjusted EV; use later decision_ms only as a deterministic tie-breaker
correction.slot_start: the pending/open global slot begins at entry_ms, not before order activation
correction.slot_end: unchanged structural exit or boundary mark semantics
correction.winner_removal: unchanged exact event removal followed by full rerouting under the corrected entry-time arbitration

unchanged: model features, labels, hyperparameters and calibration
